title: 0-1 Knapsack
description: Write a Zig program that solves the 0-1 knapsack problem using dynamic programming.
hints: 0-1 Knapsack DP: dp[i][w] = max value using first i items with weight limit w
If item i weighs too much: dp[i][w] = dp[i-1][w]
Use `@max()` built-in for finding the maximum
